How It Works

From "I need this gone"
to "It's gone."

Junk Run connects customers with independent contractors through a simple, quote-based marketplace. Post your job, choose your contractor, and track it through to done.

Post a Job → Become a Contractor →

JUNK RUN IS QUOTE-BASED — NOT A BIDDING SYSTEM.

Contractors independently review jobs and submit their own estimates. There is no live auction or bidding war.

STEP
01

Post Your Job

Tell contractors exactly what needs to be removed.

Add a before photo, your pickup address, and a date — or choose Anytime That Day. A verified payment method just needs to be on file; you're not charged for posting.

STEP
02

Receive Estimates

You're choosing between estimates — not participating in a live bidding war.

Independent contractors review your job on the HaulBoard and send their own price, availability, and a short message. For example:

Contractor A
$175
Available 2–4 PM
Contractor B
$225
Large-load capable
Contractor C
$190
Available Saturday morning
STEP
03

Choose & Pay Securely

Compare contractor ratings, completed jobs, and estimates, then choose who you want. Once you accept, your payment is authorized and held securely — the contractor isn't paid until the job is verified complete.

STEP
04

GPS-Verified Pickup

A verified pickup — not just "I'm here."

Your contractor confirms arrival through the app, and Junk Run checks their location against your pickup address before the job can start.

ARRIVAL VERIFIED
STEP
05

Job Complete & Protected

Your contractor submits an after photo, referenced against your original before photo, as proof of completion. If something isn't right, you have a short window to flag it before payment is released.

Full details on payment timing, the pickup window, and the dispute process are in our Terms & Conditions →

Get It Gone With Junk Run

Post it. Get quotes. Choose your contractor. Get it gone.

Whether you're cleaning out a garage, getting rid of furniture, moving, renovating, or simply reclaiming your space, Junk Run connects you with independent contractors who can provide estimates for your job.

For Customers Post Your Job →
For Contractors Join the Marketplace →

Junk Run connects customers with independent contractors. Junk Run does not perform hauling services — contractors are independent service providers.

About Junk Run

A simpler way to
get junk gone.

Junk Run is a technology marketplace designed to connect customers who need junk removed with independent contractors who provide those services. Customers can post a job, provide photos and pickup details, receive estimates from contractors, and choose who they want to work with. Contractors can discover available jobs, submit their own estimates, manage accepted jobs, and build their contractor profile through completed work.

Post Your Job → Become a Contractor →
WHAT IS
JUNK RUN?

A marketplace built to connect both sides.

Junk Run brings customers and independent contractors together through one platform.

Customers Post→ Contractors Review→ Contractors Submit Estimates→ Customers Choose→ The Job Gets Done

Customers describe what they need removed, provide photos and pickup information, and post their job. Independent contractors review available jobs and decide which opportunities fit their business, then each contractor determines their own estimate for the work. The customer reviews the available estimates and chooses the contractor they want — who then completes the job and submits the required completion information through the platform.

BUILT FOR
BOTH SIDES

More choice. More control.

Junk Run is built around giving each side of the marketplace a clear, straightforward role.

Built For Customers

More choice.
A clearer process.

Junk Run gives customers a straightforward way to find independent contractors for their junk-removal needs. Customers can:

  • Post jobs with photos and details
  • Receive contractor estimates
  • Review contractor information
  • Choose their contractor
  • Follow the job through the platform
  • Review completion information
  • Access their job and payment records
For Customers →
Built For Independent Contractors

More opportunities.
More control.

Junk Run gives independent contractors access to a marketplace of customer-posted jobs. Contractors can:

  • Browse available jobs
  • Review job photos and details
  • Decide which jobs interest them
  • Set their own estimates
  • Get selected directly by customers
  • Manage assigned jobs
  • Submit completion evidence
  • Track their earnings

An LLC is not required to participate as an independent contractor. Contractors may operate in their own name, while an LLC can be used if they choose to establish a formal business entity.

For Haulers →
QUOTE-BASED,
NOT BIDDING

The customer chooses. The contractor sets the estimate.

Junk Run isn't designed around a live bidding war. Contractors independently review jobs and determine what they want to charge. Customers then review the available estimates and choose the contractor they want.

Post→ Estimate→ Choose→ Complete

Simple, transparent, and easy to understand.

TECHNOLOGY THAT
CONNECTS THE PROCESS

One platform. One job from start to finish.

Junk Run brings important parts of the junk-removal process together in one platform. Depending on the job and workflow, the platform can support:

Job Posting
Customers provide photos, descriptions, pickup information, and scheduling details.
Contractor Estimates
Independent contractors submit their own estimates.
Payment Workflow
Payments move through the platform's configured payment process.
Pickup Verification
Scheduled jobs can use GPS-based contractor arrival verification.
Completion Evidence
Contractors submit completion photos and related job information.
Job Tracking
Customers and contractors can follow the status of their jobs.
Reviews & Profiles
Contractor profiles and customer feedback can help provide additional information when customers make their choice.
WHY WE BUILT
JUNK RUN

To make the process easier to understand.

Junk removal can involve multiple phone calls, unclear pricing, scheduling back-and-forth, and uncertainty about who will actually handle the job. Junk Run was designed to bring those steps into one marketplace. Instead of starting from scratch every time:

Post the job.
Receive estimates.
Choose your contractor.
Follow the job.
Get it gone.

APPROACH

Junk Run is built around giving each side a clear role.

Customers

Legal

Terms & Conditions

This page covers the Customer Agreement, Contractor Agreement, Prohibited Items policy, and Refund & Cancellation Policy for using the Junk Run marketplace.

Junk Run is a technology marketplace operated by BSJ Innovation LLC. Junk Run does not perform hauling services. Contractors are independent service providers.

Jump to a section
Customer Agreement Contractor Agreement Prohibited Items Refund & Cancellation Policy
For Customers

Customer Agreement

By posting a job on Junk Run, you agree to the following terms covering payment, pickup verification, and dispute handling.

Payment & Authorization

A verified payment method must be attached to your account before you can post a job. You are not charged simply for posting a job. Once you accept a contractor's estimate, Junk Run authorizes and holds the applicable payment while the job moves through the completion process — the contractor is not paid immediately.

Estimate Accepted→ Payment Authorized→ Pickup→ Job Completed→ Completion/Dispute Period→ Contractor Paid

GPS Pickup Verification

For scheduled pickups, the contractor confirms arrival through the app rather than a simple manual check-in. Junk Run verifies the contractor's submitted location against your pickup address, including whether they're within the required pickup window and within the arrival geofence.

250mArrival Geofence

A verified arrival becomes part of the permanent job record.

The Pickup Window

For jobs with a specific scheduled time, the contractor has a 45-minute window to arrive and complete the pickup.

  • At 30 minutes, the contractor receives a warning that 15 minutes remain.
  • If the pickup isn't completed within 45 minutes, the job is treated as a missed pickup: your payment authorization is cancelled when possible, the job is returned to the marketplace for a new contractor, the original contractor is excluded from that repost, and you're notified.

If you chose "Anytime That Day" instead of a specific time, that job uses a separate all-day window with its own deadline and advance warning.

Completion & Before/After Photos

When the contractor finishes, they submit an after photo through the app, referenced against your original before photo, along with capture time and GPS information. You can review both photos once the job is marked complete.

Dispute Process

If you believe there's a problem with a completed job, you can submit a dispute during the applicable dispute window. Payment is not finalized immediately when a dispute is submitted — the job enters a disputed status for administrative review, and you'll receive confirmation that it's under review.

For Contractors

Contractor Agreement

By accepting jobs through Junk Run, independent contractors agree to the following terms covering estimates, pickup, earnings, and accountability.

Estimates & Selection

Junk Run is quote-based, not a live bidding system. You independently review each job and submit your own price, availability, and message. Once a customer accepts your estimate, the job is assigned to you and removed from the open marketplace.

Pickup & GPS Verification

For scheduled pickups: Navigate → submit "I'm Here" → arrival is checked against the pickup location and geofence → start the job. Your verified arrival becomes part of the job record.

The 45-Minute Pickup Window

Your pickup window begins at the scheduled time.

  • At 30 minutes (15 minutes remaining), you'll receive a warning.
  • At 45 minutes, if the pickup hasn't been completed, the job can be returned to the marketplace, the missed pickup is recorded, and you can be excluded from the reposted job.

Only accept jobs you can realistically complete within the required window. "Anytime That Day" jobs use a different all-day window — check each job's specific terms.

Completion Evidence & Payout

Submit an after photo, capture time, and GPS information through the app when the job is finished. Your payout is released once the job successfully passes the completion and applicable dispute review period. Your dashboard tracks total, weekly, monthly, and yearly earnings, completed and cancelled jobs, refunds, processing fees, and net earnings.

Contractor Accountability

Customers depend on contractors showing up for jobs they've accepted. Repeated missed pickups carry the following consequences:

1st Missed Pickup

Written warning

2nd Missed Pickup

48-hour suspension

3rd Missed Pickup

7-day suspension

4th Missed Pickup

Account deactivation

No LLC Required

You do not need an LLC to join Junk Run — you can participate as an independent contractor in your own name. An LLC is optional.

LLC Required?
No.
LLC Preferred?
It can be.

As an independent contractor, you're responsible for your own business operations, vehicle and equipment, licenses and permits, insurance, taxes, and legal/regulatory compliance, including the safe handling and transportation of materials.

Safety

Prohibited Items Policy

Junk Run does not allow hazardous or otherwise prohibited materials to be posted for removal through the marketplace.

Customers should only post items that can legally and safely be handled by the contractor they select. Contractors should review a job's description and photos before submitting an estimate and confirm they are legally and safely equipped to perform the work — if a job includes a prohibited or hazardous item, don't accept it.

NOT SURE IF SOMETHING QUALIFIES?

If a material requires special handling or licensed disposal, use a service that's equipped for that specific material instead of posting it through Junk Run.

Payments

Refund & Cancellation Policy

How cancellations, refunds, and missed pickups are handled for both customers and contractors.

Customer Cancellations

  • Cancelling before the scheduled pickup time begins: no cancellation fee.
  • Cancelling after the scheduled pickup time begins: a 5% cancellation fee applies.

Contractor Cancellations

If a selected contractor cancels, the job automatically returns to the open marketplace and you can select another available estimate.

Missed Pickups

If the required pickup process isn't completed within the 45-minute window (or the applicable "Anytime That Day" window), the job is treated as a missed pickup: your payment is refunded according to the missed-pickup process, and the job is reposted to the marketplace. The contractor who missed the pickup is excluded from that repost.

Questions about any of these policies? Check the FAQ or reach out through your Junk Run account.
